connector.name: Sops MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for creating and managing SOPS-encrypted secrets
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package sops-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the privacyplaybook account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SOPS_MCP_AGE_PUBLIC_KEY
env.description: Age recipient public key. Required at startup.

env.name: SOPS_AGE_KEY
env.description: Age private key. Required at call time for any mutation tool (decrypt + re-encrypt). Read-only tools do not need it.
